groups.text: Attracted by the boom in America, my nephew teamed up with a Korean to illegally cross the Bering Strait in the Arctic to America. To avoid the Customs’ punishment, they hid in a small ferry called the North Pole Seagull, sitting back to back without sleeping, showering and shaving for 3 days, and had no chance to mourn their lost luggage when landing. The hardship of this crossing was apparent.
groups.zh: 受到美国繁荣景象的吸引，我的侄子和一个韩国人结伴，非法穿过北极地区的白令海峡，前往美国。为了躲避海关的处罚，他们藏在一艘名叫“北极海鸥”的小渡船里，背靠背地坐着，不睡觉，三天没有洗澡，也没有刮胡子，上岸时，连为丢失的行李难过一下的机会都没有。这次横渡的艰辛显而易见。

groups.text: At first, he made a living by means of raising cattle and then was hired in aircraft industries. He lived in a Catholic district. Taking in a small percentage of Pakistani immigrants, the majority of the residents were from Italy and Denmark, who all kept up their customs and cultures.
groups.zh: 起初，他靠养牛谋生，后来受雇于航空工业。他住在一个天主教社区。那里接纳了少量巴基斯坦移民，但大多数居民来自意大利和丹麦，他们都保留着自己的习俗和文化。

groups.text: Different blocks here were distinctly marked out and indicated from the racial angle. It was unfair and needed reforming. But with nowhere else to go, my nephew lived on and managed to make a life for himself.
groups.zh: 这里的不同街区按种族被清楚地划分和标示出来。这很不公平，需要改革。但是，因为没有别的地方可去，我的侄子继续住下，努力为自己谋生活。

groups.text: My nephew’s fortune came when he bravely helped a conductor brake a tram to stop it from slipping out of the rails. The man was elected vice chairman of the Socialist Party later. It occurred to my nephew that he could grasp this opportunity to ask for his help.
groups.zh: 侄子的好运来了，当他勇敢地帮助一名列车员刹住电车，阻止电车脱轨时。后来，那个人当选为社会党的副主席。我的侄子忽然想到，自己可以抓住这个机会，向他寻求帮助。

groups.text: The man who was thankful helped him apply to the civil authority for the right to live in America by inserting his brave deed into his documents. Unlike a great many other applicants, his application was approved by the Federal Justice Ministry. Before long, he started his own bakery and lived a better life.
groups.zh: 那个人心怀感激，帮助侄子向民政机构申请，申请在美国居住的权利，把他的英勇事迹补充进申请材料。与许多其他申请人不同，他的申请获得了联邦司法部门的批准。不久，他开了自己的面包店，生活有了改善。
